transcript.content: Hi, welcome. What brings you in today?

Um... well, I guess my eating has just gotten really off lately. Some days I barely get down coffee and a granola bar before a shift. And... my scrubs have been hanging loose on me. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything. Just... that's what brings me in, I guess.
Are you avoiding food because you’re worried about your weight or body shape?
No. I'm... I'm not worried about my weight. I told you, I'm not trying to lose weight. I just... I don't know, I just don't have an appetite, I guess.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
...Yeah. I guess. It's just... most mornings I wake up with this... heavy, hollow feeling. Like the day is already ruined before I even put my badge on. So, yeah.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

...Yeah. I suppose. I just... don't really do much anymore. I used to run up in Van Cortlandt Park... take photos, maybe play chess with some guys. But... I don't know. Lately I just tell myself there's no point to any of it. So I just end up sitting at home. Mostly just scrolling... or looking at my budget spreadsheet. Just... yeah.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

...No. I mean, I haven't... I haven't planned anything. I wouldn't do that. But... sometimes I just think it would be easier if I wasn't here. Like if I just... went to sleep and didn't wake up. It just crosses my mind, that's all.
Did something stressful happen before all this started?

...I don't know if I'd call it stressful, exactly. But... things changed at work. They did this big overhaul with the EMR system and... changed our workflow. My hours got shifted around. That was... almost two years ago now. I guess that's when it all started.
Since this started, have you felt this way more days than not for the past two years?

...Yeah. I guess so. It's... it's been pretty constant. Just that heavy feeling, you know? Like... empty. It hasn't just been a couple of bad weeks. It's... mostly been like this. For most of that time.
During these past two years, was there ever a stretch of two months or longer when you did not feel this heavy, empty way?
...No. I don't think so. It's... it's just been there. I haven't really had a break from it.
Have you lost weight since your appetite got worse?

...Yeah. I suppose. My eating has just been... off. Some days I barely get down a coffee and a granola bar before my shift. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, but... my scrubs have been hanging loose lately.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
...Not really. I mean... I do my work. I get through the day. I haven't noticed anything... different with that.
During this time, have you been feeling badly about yourself?

...Yeah. I guess so. I just... I feel like I'm always in the way. Like I'm a burden to the clinic, and to my family. If I take too long turning over a room, I just... I can't stop thinking about it. Like I ruined everyone's whole day just by being slow. It's stupid, but... yeah. I blame myself a lot.
Have you been feeling low on energy?

...Yeah. I am. It's... it's pretty bad. Even if I spend the whole night in bed, I wake up and my body just... it feels like I already worked a double shift. By the time lunch rolls around, I'm just... I'm really fighting to keep my thoughts together. It's just heavy.
Have you been feeling hopeless?
...No, not really. I don't think about it like that. I just... I know I have to keep working. So I just try to get through the shift.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energized, or irritable for several days in a row?
...No. I don't think so. I don't really get like that. Mostly I just... I'm just tired.
How has your sleep been lately?

...It's not great. I just... I don't sleep through the night. I lie there, and I'm just going over everything from work, and... listening. For noises, I guess. And then I usually wake up around 3 or 4, and I just... I can't get back to sleep before my alarm goes off. So, yeah. Not great.
During this time, was there ever a period when your depression got noticeably worse for at least two weeks in a row?

...I don't know about worse. It's just... it's always there. For a long time now, really. I just feel... heavy, I guess. Like I don't care about much of anything anymore. It's not just a couple of bad weeks... it's just how it is. Most of the time.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, even about everyday things?
...Not really. I don't think so. Just... the normal amount, I guess. I don't really get worked up over little things.
